title: VTC Directory — Introduce — payload
description: A member asks the community to introduce them to another member's entry, offering a fresh pairwise DID to reply to. The answer is always `accepted`, so the request reveals nothing about the other member. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

replyTo.description: A pairwise DID the sender's agent minted for this relationship alone. The introduced member answers it directly, never through the community.

message.description: A short note to the introduced member. Plain text.

share.description: Fields of the sender's own card to include. The community fills their values from the card and drops any whose visibility does not already cover the recipient.

Response.title: VTC Directory — Introduce — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/directory/introduce/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/directory/introduce/0.1#response.
